pos.personaBrief: Brazil dominated possession and worked the ball methodically until a quick burst created chances (Football Faithful), while also seeking counters whenever possible; possession is the base.

pro.personaBrief: A 3-2-5 and diamond build-up with Casemiro dropping between centre-backs shows patient construction, but the team is direct once the ball is won (Sky Sports 'very direct', counter-attacks as quickly as possible).

est.personaBrief: Defined phases (3-2-5, 4-4-2 mid-block) with set roles, yet Tite gave Neymar creative freedom and the full-backs and midfielders rotated; wingers hug the touchline.

lar.personaBrief: Raphinha and Vinicius hugging the touchline made the team direct; wingers were seen as essential, and full-backs were not auxiliary wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Aggressive counter-press in central areas, pressing forwards (Richarlison, Jesus) and aggressive pressing in the 2019 final; the 4-4-2 mid-block is compact but not deep.

mar.personaBrief: No verified marking evidence; Tite is a zonal-marking coach at club level, and the team focused on zones and sides (Peru final) rather than a dedicated man-marker.

pla.personaBrief: Same idea with tweaks, three consolidated ways of playing, adjustments by game (Sky Sports), and a specific plan for Guerrero in the 2019 final; Tite adapted to the players he had.

res.personaBrief: Attack-minded Brazil that wants to win and dominates, rotating and seeking a result; Tite's cycle was judged by results, with a pragmatic closing of games.

sis.personaBrief: Neymar had a structure built around him and creative freedom (Jovem Pan), wingers beat men one-on-one, but Tite also demanded organised roles and pressing from forwards.

jog.personaBrief: Technical players like Neymar, Paqueta and Coutinho, Casemiro as a reading-and-covering midfielder, but pace and physical intensity of Vinicius ('six or seven gears') were prized.

bas.personaBrief: A national team picking from clubs, mixing veterans (Alves, Thiago Silva) with a youth wave (Vinicius, Raphinha, Rodrygo), selected by 'best moment' and confidence.

lid.personaBrief: Tite combined authority with equity ('igualdade nao, equidade sim'), managed people with care and freedom for attackers, and listened to the group.
